method.lede: A rigorous protocol evaluating how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini & Perplexity perceive, rank, and recommend your brand.
method.note: ChatGPT's scraped responses sometimes omit source URLs, so its citation rate can appear lower than its actual on-screen behavior. Gemini has limited recall on emerging brands and may return empty responses for some queries. Claude and Perplexity reliably return both full text and citations across all three phases.
